styles.name: mobius-strip
styles.description: A one-sided Möbius strip unfurling along its parametric u-axis as progress advances, rotating lazily on time

styles.name: torus-wireframe
styles.description: Latitude/longitude wireframe of a (R=1, r=0.38) torus, circles revealed row-by-row as progress grows

styles.name: torus-knot
styles.description: (2,3) torus knot traced on a torus surface — a trefoil path that wraps twice around the tube for every three loops of the core

styles.name: trefoil-knot
styles.description: Trefoil knot: x=sin t+2sin 2t, y=cos t−2cos 2t, z=−sin 3t — the simplest non-trivial knot, spinning on time

styles.name: klein-bottle
styles.description: Figure-8 immersion of the Klein bottle in ℝ³ — a non-orientable surface with no inside revealed petal by petal

styles.name: hopf-fibers
styles.description: Three Hopf fibration circles stereographically projected from S³ — every fiber is a great circle linking every other

styles.name: sphere-inflate
styles.description: Unit sphere wireframe expanding from a point to full radius as progress grows, spinning on time

styles.name: helix-climb
styles.description: Double helix on a cylinder — two strands climb in opposite phase as progress advances, rotating with time

styles.name: saddle-surface
styles.description: Hyperbolic paraboloid z = x²−y² wireframe — the canonical saddle point, revealed as a grid of iso-lines, rotating with time

styles.name: tesseract-spin
styles.description: 4-D hypercube (tesseract) rotated in the XW and YZ planes then perspective-projected to 2-D — edges revealed by progress, spinning on time

styles.name: roman-surface
styles.description: Steiner's Roman surface — one of the most beautiful immersions of ℝP² into ℝ³, with six Whitney umbrella singularities, revealed petal by petal

styles.name: seifert-ramp
styles.description: Seifert-surface-inspired spiral ramp spanning a trefoil knot boundary — a twisted disk that rises through a full turn as progress advances
